label: Late original-phase / <DEL> step after g,3,m-type tokens, on c/a/digit inputs
explanation: Fires almost only in the input half of the sequence: about half its mass is at the <DEL> step (29% of <DEL> steps are active) and the other half is on original-phase steps. Its rate rises with position (zero at t=0, about 2% at t=2, 19% at orig_idx 8) and it is nearly silent during the copy phase (1.8% of mass). Which steps fire depends on token content. The current input is usually <DEL> or c, a, 2, 0, k, d or n, and usually a first occurrence (94% of mass has in_first=1). Earlier inputs usually include tokens from the set g, 3, m, x, t, e, v, b, and an early g/3/m (first_tok or prev2_tok) gives the biggest lift, around 2.7x. The predicate (input half, current token in the first set, at least two tokens from the second set seen earlier) gets dev P=0.47, R=0.61, F1=0.53, mass recall 0.73. Coverage rises with activation size (43% of the lowest quartile, 84% of the top quartile), so the strongest activations follow this pattern best. Precision is limited because the unit acts like a graded function of the accumulated hidden state rather than a crisp condition: many <DEL> steps with matching tokens stay below threshold. Does not fire on t=0, copy-phase steps or repeated tokens.
